 Maryland Youth Advisory Council 
 Be a Part of the Policies & Programs That Affect Your Future 
 Join the Maryland Youth Advisory Council! Here's your opportunity to have a voice:
 Be active and passionate representatives of Maryland youth.
 Identify and discuss issues facing youth in Maryland.
 Work with other council members to create strategies that address these issues.
 Develop leadership skills.
 Meet other Maryland youth.
 Have fun!
 Download an application (PDF) and get started today!
